display_name: 定向 KL 矩阵技术恢复
description: 复用上一批已完成的同一 E50，只补训 OOM 和未启动行，再完成独立评分。
authorization: 用户要求扩大 Tri 优化实验，除 GPU 7 外每卡最多 4 个计算进程。

code.commit: actual committed release identity in runtime.json

data.dataset: original ten-class ManyRx and six-source receiver contracts

roles.U_s: TX blind in training; offline diagnostic only after E50

data.support_query_ref: fixed clean cross-date, cross-RX and double-cross; prediction before independent scoring
data.leo_config_ref: not applicable: clean-only, no new satellite observations

permissions.query_use: frozen raw clean prediction; independent truth-last scoring
permissions.claim_scope: seed selected by previously exposed clean target; exploratory, not an independent blind evaluation

checkpoint.initialization: matching original same-setting source-only Tri E20 then own E21–E50
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: same source roles, physical IDs, seed and original source-only E20, no target-trained checkpoint
checkpoint.selection_rule: all fixed rows E50; candidate design uses previously exposed clean, so exploration only

execution.gpu_policy: GPU 0–6 only; maximum two CUDA processes per card including other owners; minimum admission 12 GiB
execution.stop_rule: On protocol, nonfinite or launch failure stop new dispatch; preserve all outputs and healthy workers; no low-score stops.

expected_artifacts: 28 fixed E50 predictions and truth-last clean scores
stepwise KL and L/U gradients plus same-state AdamW samples

metric_names: U acceptance, unique coverage and post-freeze correctness
group raw and applied gradients, reference conflicts and caps
every-100-step actual joint and same-state reference-only AdamW direction

notes: All candidates set base pseudo-label CE=0 while retaining fixed shallow/fusion auxiliary components.
Original six training forwards and original raw U acceptance forward; detached teachers are computed from these exact outputs.
Same acceptance mask and full-population denominator. T=2 scales KL by T².
Use historical fixed-view symmetric KL control at the matching setting and nominal dose when available; all rows compare to same-seed PL.
Source-only E20 ancestry and E50 selection, then clean-only prediction with independent scoring and frozen-only U diagnostics.
Stop new dispatch only on the registered systemic technical or protocol failure; preserve healthy workers.
Previous controller must reach PARTIAL_TECHNICAL_FAILURE after all healthy workers exit.
Frozen rows reused only by exact source contract, model seed, recipe, parent and blind observations. No performance selection.
Terminal source OOM rows and queued rows get independent E20-to-E50 execution at the same seed, doses and budget.
